title: Cross-Model Adoption Trajectory Playbook & Regional Signal Integrator
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: build a repeatable playbook and lightweight data pipeline that converts continuous market signals (open model capability changes, regional latency/cost shifts, vendor availability alerts) into ranked adoption trajectories and procurement triggers for Redwood product and GTM teams.

Why: teams need an operationalized view of which model variants and regions to prioritize for Dedicated/Private offers, when to recommend quantization fallbacks, and which enterprise customers require early outreach when vendor risk rises. Current docs are ad-hoc spreadsheets and weekly notes — this ticket scopes a 6-week sprint to deliver a reproducible process, dashboard wireframe, and two example signal-to-action flows.

Scope:
- Define signal taxonomy and weighting for adoption momentum (capability delta, latency arbitrage, license risk, regional availability).
- Build a minimal aggregator (pub/sub + transform) that ingests: public model releases, telemetry from hosted API (latency/availability), third-party market feeds, and field sales reports.
- Create ranking heuristics and a simple scoring function that outputs: adoption_score, fallback_score, procurement_alert_level.
- Productize outputs as: (a) internal model-priority table for provisioning and (b) a one-pane dashboard for PM/PS/sales with suggested outreach actions.
- Deliver two worked examples: enterprise-finserv scenario (latency-sensitive embeddings) and a PLG product scenario (chat fallback economics).

Out of scope for this ticket: full ML model training for prediction, long-term storage retention policy, formal SLA changes for Dedicated customers. Those will be covered by follow-ups if this proves valuable.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy document reviewed and approved by Research and Product (confluence link)
Working ingestion demo that normalizes at least 3 signal types (release feeds, latency telemetry, sales reports)
Scoring function prototype that ranks 20 candidate model+region pairs and explains top 5 drivers per decision
Dashboard wireframe and JSON-backed prototype accessible to PM/PS/Sales with filtering by region and customer tier
Two example runbooks (finserv, PLG) that map score outputs to concrete next steps (provision, outreach, canary)

Data proto: wire up ingestion for public model releases (scraper + normalized schema) - Eng - 3 days
Telemetry join: sample 7-day latency/availability slice for hosted API by region - Eng - 2 days
Sales input: collect 6 representative RFI/RFP snippets from field - PM - 4 business days
Scoring rules: implement initial heuristic rules and unit tests - Eng - 3 days
Dashboard: low-fidelity wireframe -> clickable prototype with example filters - Design - 4 days
Runbooks: author two example playbooks and review with Solutions Eng - PM - 3 days
Stakeholder review: present prototype to GTM, SE, Research - 2026-03-11
risks_and_mitigation: Signal noise - mitigation: require minimum signal counts and apply exponential smoothing
Data freshness - mitigation: prioritize real-time telemetry; mark stale signal windows in UI
Misalignment with procurement - mitigation: include procurement in workshops and map thresholds to contractual options
Overfitting heuristics - mitigation: keep scoring transparent and parameterized; expose sliders in prototype
